name: WPG Addons for Elementor
author: Rakesh Raja

sections.description:
WPG Addons for Elementor adds a curated set of custom Elementor widgets to help you build richer layouts faster.

Included widgets:
* Form
* Advanced Map
* Menu
* Posts
* Slider
* Ajax Search
* Image Accordion
* Video Gallery
* Image Gallery
* Pricing Table
* Tabs
* Review
* Dynamic Field
* FAQ
* Image Hotspot
* Popup Panel
* Hover Image
* Flipbox
* CTA Builder
* Service Timeline
* Table of Contents
* Before/After
* Logo Carousel
* Breadcrumbs
* Sticky Element
* Count Up
* Announcement Bar
* Video Lightbox
* Lottie Animation
* Countdown
* Progress Bar
* Creative Button

External Services

This plugin can connect to third-party services when certain widgets are enabled and configured. No data is sent unless you use those widgets and provide the required keys or media URLs.

Google Maps JavaScript API

  • Used by: Advanced Map widget.
  • What is sent: Your configured API key, map center coordinates, zoom, and marker data you enter in the widget. Requests are made from the visitor browser when a page with the map widget loads.
  • Terms: https://cloud.google.com/maps-platform/terms/
  • Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google reCAPTCHA

  • Used by: Form widget (optional v2 or v3).
  • What is sent: Site key/secret you configure under WPG Addons > Integration, plus browser/request tokens Google needs to verify submissions. Siteverify runs server-side on form submit; the reCAPTCHA script loads in the browser when the form widget is present.
  • Terms: https://www.google.com/intl/en/policies/terms/
  • Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • reCAPTCHA FAQ: https://developers.google.com/recaptcha

YouTube

  • Used by: Video Gallery / Video Lightbox widgets when you provide a YouTube URL.
  • What is sent: The video URL/ID you enter; YouTube may set cookies and collect viewer data when the embed loads.
  • Terms: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms
  • Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Vimeo

  • Used by: Video widgets when you provide a Vimeo URL. Thumbnail lookup may use Vimeo oEmbed.
  • What is sent: The video URL/ID you enter; Vimeo may collect viewer data when the embed loads.
  • Terms: https://vimeo.com/terms
  • Privacy: https://vimeo.com/privacy

Lottie JSON (optional URL)

  • Used by: Lottie Animation widget when you supply a remote JSON URL.
  • What is sent: A request for that animation file from the visitor browser. A bundled local demo JSON is included; remote URLs are optional and only used if you set them.
  • If you load a third-party animation URL, follow that provider’s terms and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wpg-addons-for-elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and active.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and active. WordPress will prompt to install Elementor if it is missing (Requires Plugins header).

What happens to my data if I uninstall the plugin?

Uninstalling deletes integration settings, widget enable/disable preferences, cached transients, and all stored form entries. Elementor page content is not removed, but widgets from this plugin may show as missing until you remove or replace them.

Does this plugin store form submissions?

The Form widget can store submissions in the WordPress database if enabled in the widget settings.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release with 32 Elementor widgets.
  • Admin dashboard with widget manager and integration settings (reCAPTCHA, Google Maps).
  • Form widget with optional entry storage, email notifications, reCAPTCHA, validation, and rate limiting.
  • Conditional frontend asset loading per widget.
